args: Interpret the active runtime user instruction, identifying its movable object and receiving object, not a goal inferred solely from appearance. Set applicability. This method supports a rigid rectangular package resting flat on a visible plane and an open approximately horizontal circular receiver. geometry=adequate only if that identity, the flat support relation and visible top perimeter are unambiguous. Supply camera and four cyclic top-face corner pixels, not an object-center depth guess. Request tight named regions top, support and floor using explicit camera, box, stride=4: top is only the flat package top interior; support is adjacent exposed support; floor is a visible low interior receiver surface. Request six distributed inner-rim points r0..r5 at the opening lip, not the outside silhouette. Request three separated noncollinear interior texture landmarks l0,l1,l2 on the package top. definitions must describe their persistent physical printed features, not screen-relative names. Supply patch_camera and an interior textured patch_polygon on the same package, possibly a different camera from the outline; null if unavailable. All text English ASCII.

result.explanation: The active instruction identifies the cream cheese package as the movable object and the patterned bowl as the receiver. The labeled rectangular package rests flat on the tabletop, with its complete top perimeter visible. The bowl has an open, approximately horizontal circular lip and a visible low interior surface.

definitions: l0: Center of the curled stroke of the initial capital C in the printed word Cream.
l1: Center of the curled stroke of the initial capital C in the printed word Cheese.
l2: Apex of the broad dark-blue outer oval arc opposite the smaller inset oval emblem.
